sources.title: A LGBM model for predicting alimentary tract hemorrhage ... - Frontiers
sources.snippet: The LGBM model had good discrimination and calibration, as confirmed by internal validation using train–test split and 10-fold cross-validation. The model uses predictors that are easily available and biologically plausible, and the inclusion of long-term functional outcomes demonstrates the clinical importance of postoperative ATH.
